subject: Follow-up: hosting option reconciliation & trial plan for Veridian Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liz Bennett <liz@veridianhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + clarification on hosting constraints and PoC asks

Hi Liz / Samir — thanks again for the demo call today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can lock the right trial path.

Key constraints you mentioned on the call:
- PHI scope for 3 endpoints (clinical notes ingestion, patient messaging, discharge summaries).
- No raw transcript retention in any public/shared storage; audit logs required for all inference calls.
- Procurement will require an initial security questionnaire and evidence (SOC2 report, data flow diagram).

High-level options we discussed (recap):
1) Hosted API — fastest to start, but you flagged retention and PHI concerns unless we enable private tenancy options.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPUs in our infra, gives tenancy/isolation and predictable throughput; still hosted in Redwood’s environment.
3) Private VPC / on-prem — customer-managed network and full control; longer setup and procurement.

Clarifying questions (can you confirm by EOD Friday?):
- Is any part of the trial allowed to process de-identified data only, or must all trial data be PHI-protected from day 1?
- Do you have an existing KMS/HSM provider we must integrate with for encryption-at-rest keys?
- Target date for having a first runnable PoC (demoable to your clinical team)? You mentioned early October as a ballpark.

Proposed next step from our side: I’ll draft a short PoC charter with two paths — a fast-path using Dedicated capacity to validate latency/throughput and a privacy-path showing Private VPC deployment for security sign-off. Each path will include success criteria and a 6-week timeline.

Attaching a one-page charter template (redwood-poc-charter-v1.docx) and a checklist of typical MSP/procurement asks.

If that aligns, I’ll also loop in Marissa (solutions) and Aditya (pricing) to get preliminary numbers and an ETA for a Private VPC kickoff.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-poc-charter-v1.docx (docx), veridian_msp_requirements.pdf (pdf)
From: Liz Bennett <liz@veridianhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@veridianhealth.com>, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + clarification on hosting constraints and PoC asks

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Data protection: all trial data will be treated as PHI. We can’t do de-identified trials for clinical endpoints. That means any host must meet our encryption and audit requirements from day one.
2) KMS: we use AWS KMS in our account and prefer a deployment that can either integrate with our KMS or allow us to manage keys.
3) Timeline: early October is still the target for a demo to the clinical team; ideal date window is Oct 6–10. Procurement will need 2 weeks from receipt of the security packet to return a signed NDA and SOW (we're fast but want to be realistic).

Preference: given our regulatory posture, we are leaning toward Private VPC. However, we understand the ramp time — if you can show a Dedicated path that preserves encryption and provides audit logs, we could run a short Dedicated-stage PoC strictly for performance validation, with a gated switch to Private VPC for production. That would reduce initial friction.

Procurement notes (for Aditya / Marissa): our procurement team needs:
- SOC 2 Type II report
- Data flow diagram showing where PHI is processed and stored
- Sample contract language for data processing and breach notifications

I’ve cc’d procurement; they’ll expect the security packet by next Tuesday to keep to our timeline.

Thanks —
Liz Bennett
VP, Product
Veridian Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liz Bennett <liz@veridianhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + clarification on hosting constraints and PoC asks

Liz / Samir — appreciate the specifics. Proposal below that maps to your constraints and the Oct 6–10 demo window.

Recommended two-stage PoC (timeline oriented):
Stage A — Performance validation (2 weeks)
- Environment: Redwood Dedicated capacity (isolated GPU pool), with customer-owned KMS integration for encryption-at-rest.
- Goal: validate 95th-percentile latency < 350ms for 1K QPS simulated clinical workload and throughput for batch inference.
- Success criteria: latency target met under target concurrency, KV-cache effectiveness > 40% on representative prefix set, and token cost estimates accepted by Veridian engineering.
- Deliverables: performance report, model configuration, replayed request traces (redacted), and audit log samples.

Stage B — Security & production parity (3–4 weeks)
- Environment: Private VPC deployment (customer-managed VPC with our private control plane).
- Goal: full security sign-off from procurement and security team; integration with Veridian AWS KMS; no PHI stored outside Veridian-controlled storage.
- Success criteria: SOC2 evidence accepted, data flow diagram approved, weekly audit-trail generation and retrieval verified, and SLOs comparable to Stage A within 15% delta.

Proposed schedule to hit Oct 6 demo:
- Week of Aug 30: deliver security packet (SOC2, data flow, sample DPA / SOW).
- Week of Sep 6: procurement review (procurement target 2 weeks).
- Week of Sep 20: Stage A dedicated capacity kickoff (2 weeks).
- Week of Oct 4: Stage A wrap, performance demo Oct 6–8.
- Week of Oct 11: Stage B private VPC kickoff, if procurement sign-off completed.

Stakeholders (suggested):
- Veridian: Liz (Product), Samir (Platform), Procurement lead (procurement@veridianhealth.com)
- Redwood: Karthik (PoC owner), Marissa (solutions lead), Aditya (commercial/pricing), Security (we will include SOC2 contact in packet)

Action items I’ll take on immediately:
- Send the security packet by Mon Aug 30 (I’ve attached the SOC2 pointer and a draft data flow).
- Get a ballpark pricing estimate for a 2-week Dedicated trial + Private VPC onboarding (Aditya, can you drop a preliminary estimate and a few variant pricing options?).
- Marissa — can you confirm resource needs for Stage A (test harness, traffic generator, and integration points)?

Attachments: redwood-poc-charter-v1.docx (docx) — I’ve updated success metrics and the timeline. Link to HubSpot deal in the packet.

If that plan looks good, I’ll schedule the kickoff invites and a short technical deep-dive with Veridian platform engineers next Wednesday.

Thanks —
Karthik
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Veridian PoC path approved by product — need pricing & security packet

Marissa / Aditya — Liz confirmed PHI requirements and is leaning Private VPC but agreed to a staged approach (Dedicated -> Private VPC) to accelerate demo timing. Summary / asks below: 

Summary:
- Account: Veridian Health (VD-2026-117)
- External target demo window: Oct 6–10
- Agreed PoC path: Stage A Dedicated (2 weeks) for performance; Stage B Private VPC (3–4 weeks) for security parity and production onboarding.

Immediate asks:
1) Aditya — please produce a preliminary pricing worksheet with: a) 2-week Dedicated trial cost (reserved GPU pool + traffic simulation compute) b) Bulk estimate for Private VPC onboarding (one-time onboarding + monthly infra delta) c) Optional add-on: extended observability & audit log retention (30/90/365 days). Deadline: Mon Aug 30 COB so I can include numbers in the security packet.
2) Marissa — confirm test harness requirements (traffic generator, sample dataset constraints for PHI redaction in replay), expected Redwood engineering FTE estimate, and whether we need a pre-signed SOW template. Also confirm which of our engineers should be on the technical kickoff (suggest: one infra engineer + one solutions architect). Deadline: Mon Aug 30 EOD.
3) Security: I will attach the SOC2 summary and data flow but we need the full pointer to our Type II report and a contact in case procurement wants an in-depth call. Who owns that (please advise).

Procurement path note: Veridian procurement wants the security packet by Tue Sep 1 to keep the Oct timeline. We will hold the Oct demo window pending procurement progress; Stage A can proceed only after minimal security sign-off (sample audit logs + KMS integration plan).

I’ll draft the kickoff invite for Sep 21 (tentative) for Stage A engineers once I have your inputs. Thanks — this one looks like a good logo opportunity if we keep the momentum.

Karthik
